description: Seed SQLAlchemy 2.x models as a referentially-consistent graph of test data: one call, shared parents, every foreign key verified.
rules: Create SQLAlchemy test data with seed(session, Model, relation=n, relation__child=m) instead of building objects or setting foreign key ids by hand.
seed() flushes and verifies every foreign key but never commits: commit or roll back in the caller.
Pass existing rows in parents=[...]; a shape key pointing to a parent (many-to-one) is refused.
A required JSON or custom TypeDecorator column needs generators={Model: {"column": lambda ctx: ...}}; ctx.fake is the seeded Faker.
generators= and overrides= are keyed by the database column name, not the Python attribute name.
In pytest, use the seedgraph_graph fixture (seedgraph_agraph for async), which gives each test a fresh SQLite with foreign keys enforced.
